caption:
وَمَنْ لَمْ يُصَانِعْ فِي أُمُورٍ كَثِيرَةٍ
يُضَرَّسْ بِأَنْيَابٍ وَيُوطَأْ بِمَنْسِمِ

Whoever does not use diplomacy in many matters
Will be bitten by fangs and trampled by hooves

— Zuhayr ibn Abi Sulma
Genre: Hikma
